development_data_status: already revealed by rejected v55 and used only to define causal state and verify opportunity count/geometry

economic_filter_before_execution.reason: the observable return to the prior value center or impulse origin did not provide one cost-after R under the fixed fee and slippage model
economic_filter_before_execution.retained_branch: high-impact order-flow price discovery with open-interest construction

causal_sequence: aggregate the previous three completed five-minute bars into a 15-minute aggressive-flow episode
require absolute volume-weighted taker-flow imbalance above its prior 30-day 70th percentile
require price response in the same direction as the aggressive flow
require response per unit flow above its prior 30-day 55th percentile, indicating weak absorption
require the next completed five-minute bar to continue in the same direction
require one-percent depth imbalance to be no more than mildly opposed
require one-hour open interest to increase, indicating new inventory rather than pure position closure
enter at the next executable one-minute NautilusTrader bar
invalidate after a greater-than-half retracement of the impulse plus 0.15 ATR
target a two-impulse measured move from the confirmed entry

promotion.rule: If this revealed development week fails, discard v56. If it passes, prospectively lock a fresh second week before collecting raw data.
